url.description: The author's own page, when it isn't the site's home page.

NavbarTheme.description: The Bulma theme on the navbar: `light` or `dark`.

OneOrMany.description: A page's path, such as `/blog`, or a list of them.

SearchConfig.description: Which pages the site search covers.

depth.description: How many levels below `from` to look; any depth when absent.

from.description: Only pages below this path, or these paths. Every page when absent.

menu.description: Whether the main menu gets an entry for the search. On when absent.

SearchSetting.description: `true` or `false`, or which pages to search.

SpareTile.description: A block of links for the cells child tiles leave empty.

url.description: A page's path, such as `/topics`, or a full URL.

description: Site-wide settings: `main.json` in the root of the source tree.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, so editors can complete and check it. vados itself ignores it.

author.description: Who writes the site, named in structured data and feeds. The site title when absent.

backgroundClass.description: The CSS class(es) on the page's background; `has-background-light-soft` when absent.

codeHighlight.description: Whether fenced Markdown code blocks that name a language are highlighted. On when absent.

colorScheme.description: Pins every page to Bulma's light or dark theme. Without it, pages follow the reader's colour-scheme preference.

cssFiles.description: Extra stylesheets every page loads, as URLs or paths from the site root. They must use Bulma 1.0 or later.

defaultImage.description: An image reference, like a page's `image` (`/team/alice`), shown in link previews of pages without a hero image of their own.

description.description: A short description of the site for search engines and link previews, used on every page without a `summary` of its own.

favicon.description: A file in the source root, such as `favicon.svg`, `favicon.png` or `favicon.ico`, published at the site root as every page's icon.

fediverseCreator.description: Your fediverse handle, `@user@instance`, which Mastodon shows as the author of link previews. Taken from a Mastodon social link when absent.

footerContent.description: The footer on every page: inline HTML, or the name of a `.md` or `.html` file in the source root.

includeDefaultCss.description: Whether pages also load Bulma from jsDelivr. On when absent; turn it off when `cssFiles` holds a compiled Bulma of your own.

includeDefaultJs.description: Whether pages also load vados's own script, which runs the navbar's dropdowns and burger menu. On when absent.

jsFiles.description: Extra scripts every page loads, as URLs or paths from the site root.

language.description: The site's language as a BCP 47 tag, such as `en`, `nl` or `nl-BE`; `en` when absent. It sets each page's `lang` and the language of the text vados adds itself.

markdown.description: Publishes a Markdown version of every page next to its HTML, such as `/blog/post.md`. Off when absent.

menuDropdownLimit.description: How many children a main menu dropdown lists before ending in a link to the section; 12 when absent.

mermaid.description: Whether fenced `mermaid` blocks become diagrams in the reader's browser. On when absent.

mermaidScript.description: Where pages with a diagram load Mermaid from: an http(s) module URL, or a path from the site root to a file in `staticDir`. jsDelivr when absent.

navbarColor.description: The navbar's Bulma colour; `Warning` when absent.

navbarTheme.description: Which Bulma theme sits on the navbar, for a stylesheet that recolours `navbarColor` to the opposite brightness. Without it, the colour's default brightness decides.

search.description: Publishes a site search at `/search`: `true`, or which pages to search.

siteTitle.description: The site's name: the home page's title, and part of every other page's `<title>`.

siteUrl.description: Where the site is published, such as `https://example.com`. Feeds, the sitemap, calendar files and link-preview images need it.

spareTile.description: A block of links for the cells the shorter column of tiles leaves empty, such as an archive or a way to subscribe.

staticDir.description: A directory, relative to the source root, whose files are published as they are at the site root: `robots.txt`, `_headers`, downloads.

stretchSideNotification.description: Whether the last side notification grows to end where the page's content does. Off when absent.

titleSeparator.description: What goes between a page's title and the site title in `<title>`; ` · ` when absent.

title: vados main.json
